name: live-ui-audit
summary: Audit a running interface read-only in a browser the user signed in to, across viewports and themes, verify findings against source with skeptics, and report privately plus a repository-safe copy.
triggers: accessibility audit of the running app
walk every screen and report UI issues
audit the app in the browser
exclusions: submitting forms that change stored state, or other writes
static design review without a running app
